title: The Shortest Path for a Car That Only Goes Forward: Dubins Paths, an Exact Finish for the Search, and the Loop to a Goal Just Behind You

artifact.note: Dubins paths: the shortest path between two poses for a car that goes forward only and turns no tighter than a given radius is one of six words of left arcs, right arcs and a straight line (LSL, RSR, LSR, RSL, RLR, LRL), each worked out in closed form; the path is sampled by walking the three pieces, and it finishes a hybrid search exactly on the goal pose
